_note: Accepted run08. 46.6% of every tile placed in the pack. Native 96x96, raw_only. METHOD, learned over 13 generations and costing $0.49: never name the subject. Saying 'sea water' or 'grass' invokes a lit SCENE and the model bakes in a top-to-bottom lighting gradient (measured -52) or an edge vignette (-21 to -37) that reads as a lattice once tiled. Describing the PATTERN instead -- 'a small crop cut from the middle of a much larger sheet of wrapping paper, printed with...' -- removes both: water went to -1.4, grass to +0.7. Two other levers were tested and did NOT matter: bypass_prompt_expansion (no measurable effect, -35.7 vs -34.9 on the same seed) and seed choice (three grass seeds all vignetted -21 to -33). tile_x/tile_y DO work -- they hold the wrap to under 1 level -- but they cannot stop the model shading the tile's own interior.
_replaces: 48x34, 2 colours: flat blue with magenta ripple dashes
prompt: a small crop cut from the middle of a much larger sheet of wrapping paper, the paper is printed all over with an endless repeating pattern: a flat medium blue ground covered with many small short horizontal dashes of bright pale cyan in strong contrast, the dashes evenly and randomly spread with the same density everywhere, the crop is taken from deep inside the sheet so no edge or border of the paper is visible anywhere, the pattern simply continues past all four sides, flat colours, hard edges, no blur, no gradient, no shading, no light, no depth

spec: tiles seamlessly on all four edges -- check a 3x3 montage, not the single tile
NO landmark feature: nothing a player would notice repeating across a field of 50 tiles
reads as water at 1:1 in the game, not only when zoomed
flat colour, low colour count, no gradient or vignette
even brightness corner to corner -- no lighting falloff
regressions_to_watch: a diffusion model asked for 'sea' produces a SCENE -- horizon, sky, shoreline. The prompt bans each of those explicitly because they are the default.
a bright specular highlight or sun glint becomes a repeating polka dot across the whole ocean
gradient from top to bottom shows as banding at every tile boundary
over-detailed ripples turn to mush at 1:1 even though they look fine at 8x

_review_rule: Judge it as a 3x3 tiled field beside the existing tile, at 1:1. A single tile at 8x tells you nothing about whether it repeats acceptably.
